outcome: interval from antenatal steroid administration to birth
delivery within optimal time window (1-7 days) after antenatal steroid application
delivery within 8-14 days after antenatal steroids
delivery more than 14 days after steroid application
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women who received antenatal steroids for imminent preterm birth at a single tertiary center.
finding: Most pregnant women (72.5%) do not give birth within 7 days after the administration of antenatal steroids, with the optimal timing for delivery within 1-7 days being most common for those with preeclampsia, PPROM, and FGR.
gest_age: Delivery before 34/0 weeks and before 37/0 weeks of gestation were outcomes, with the cohort receiving steroids for imminent preterm birth.
